549-6871-8095--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-6871-8095--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.
549-6871-8095--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2781-5998-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1458-2539-3400-4762-7785.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers. Choose not to copy Banishing Knack
Resolve Banishing Knack
Cast Ancestral Mask by paying {2}{G}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers, copying Ancestral Mask twice due to Twinning Staff. Choose to have one copy target Ivy and the other copy target Devoted Druid.
Resolve all three Ancestral Masks, attaching one to Ivy and two to Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid using the ability given to it by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning the nontoken Ancestral Mask from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 two additional times, then repeat step 8 one additional time.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1494-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

511-817-2557-4050-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2921-6754-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

273-944-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

413-514-654-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor, Blasting Station and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor and Mycosynth Gardens triggers, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2821-3755-5479-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by remove a charge counter from it, untapping Minamo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

147-997-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

3234-3293-4693-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4693-6797.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4693-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

147-6476-6797.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-6476-6797.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1669-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-1669-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

5010-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power, ultimately milling Golgari Thug.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting Golgari Thug from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4758-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

955-3204-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
955-3204-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

586-2034-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-2034-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2660-2707-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Time Warp is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library during your draw step due to River Song.
Repeat.

618-3195-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
618-3195-4222.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dromar's Attendant with haste.
Activate the Dromar's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

578-4222-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-4222-4720.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

2290-4185-4613.notablePrerequisites: Celestial Unicorn has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2290-4185-4613.description:
Activate Celestial Unicorn using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Celestial Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

914-1692-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1692-2011.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1462-2763.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least four loyalty counters.
1462-2763.description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Kaya and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Kaya token.

147-4598.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Essence Flux.
147-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Essence Flux, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Essence Flux, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-2445-3263.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-2445-3263.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

276-282-2822.notablePrerequisites:
Delina is your commander and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
276-282-2822.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Angrath's Marauders that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Delina, dealing at least twelve commander damage to an opponent.
Kediss triggers, causing Delina to deal at least forty-eight damage to each other opponent.

593-2615-4150.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Mogg Maniac has selected the opponent that will be targeted with Tree of Perdition.
593-2615-4150.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Shivan Meteor for {3}{R}{R}, dealing thirteen damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.

65-717-2628-4310-4652.description:
Activate Blasted Landscape's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Blasted Landscape, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasted Landscape trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Blasted Landscape and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
